BUCCANEER

An early build: put to sea, take prizes, and bring the loot home to share out. You lay the guns; your crew sails her.
MouseMove the aiming point. Guns that can reach it swivel onto it.
ClickFire the gun that bears best.
Hold · releaseStaggered broadside from every loaded gun that bears. Bow and stern chasers join in when she's ahead or astern.
GunneryShot falls and scatters. Aim above distant targets; the range shows at the cursor.
TargetsMast base: topple it · Rudder: wreck her steering · Gun deck: knock out guns · Waterline: flood her · Hold amidships: spill her stores
Keys 1 to 5Helm orders: close, hold range, open range, break off, board her. The buttons at the top do the same.
BoardingLay her aboard and your people go over the rail, in green scarves. Click to fire your pistol into her people. A ball that finds your own man is a man lost.
Key 6 · ParleySignal for terms and hold your fire. If she holds hers, a boat crosses and a price is named.
Right-drag · wheelLook around · zoom
Key MMusic on or off
